question: The Konkan Railway line passes through which of the following groups of states?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Maharashtra, Goa and Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Konkan Railway** is a significant railway line that connects the western coastal region of India.
 
• It primarily passes through the states of **Maharashtra, Goa, and Karnataka**, making it a crucial link for these regions.
 
• The Konkan Railway covers a picturesque route that runs along the **Konkan coast**, known for its lush green landscapes, rivers, and tunnels.
 
• This railway line is known for its **engineering marvels**, including long tunnels and high bridges.
 
• The **Roha to Thokur** section marks the stretch of the Konkan Railway, spanning approximately **741 km**.
 
• It was constructed by the **Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL)**, a subsidiary of the Indian Railways.
 
• The line is vital for the transportation of passengers and goods, significantly boosting the **economic development** of the Konkan region.
 
• It also plays an important role in promoting **tourism**, as it connects popular tourist destinations like **Goa** and the coastal regions of Karnataka.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh** is a central state in India and does not lie along the western coastal region. Hence, it is not part of the Konkan Railway route.
 
• **Telangana** is a state in southern India, but it is an inland region and does not fall along the **Konkan coast**.
 
• Although **Gujarat** is located on the western coast, it is not part of the **Konkan Railway network**. The Konkan Railway is specific to the Konkan coastal strip.
